exposure: No-scar group (no surgical history involving the uterus)
Scarred uterus group (history of myomectomy and/or cesarean section)
cohort: 140 patients who underwent embolization for symptomatic fibroids
finding: There was no statistically significant difference in technical and clinical outcomes of uterine fibroid embolization (UFE) between patients with a scarred uterus (previous myomectomy or cesarean section) and those without a surgical history involving the uterus.
